page.content:
Two-seat program that rehearsed rendezvous, EVA, and long-duration flight.

How Project Gemini connects

  • Topic: NASA — Project Gemini was NASA's rendezvous-and-EVA rehearsal for Apollo.
  • Faction: Apollo program — Apollo followed Gemini once rendezvous and EVA had been proven.
  • Faction: Project Mercury — Gemini followed Mercury as NASA's second crewed program.

What is Project Gemini?

Project Gemini (1961–66) trained the Apollo generation: orbital rendezvous, spacewalks, and two-week missions that made a lunar landing operationally plausible.

Key threads lead to NASA, Apollo program and Project Mercury.
